note: quince#199. An actor this tool cannot resolve must land on `unknown`, never on the empty string. THIS IS A LOOP FIXTURE ON PURPOSE: the defect lived in the SHAPING (`.login // "unknown"`, where jq's `//` falls through on null and false but not on ""), which is the impure half — a pure `before`/`after` pair would have to hand-write the already-shaped `actor` and could assert nothing about the bug. Driving the real verb against a stub carries the payload through gh-array-to-graphql.jq and FETCH_NORMALISE, which is the round trip that reproduces the empty string `gh` really emits. Field shapes are real: novkostya/quince-devlog#117 is a live PR whose commit author resolves to no GitHub account, and `gh pr list --json commits` renders its author as `login: ""`. All four actor kinds appear, because #199's acceptance asks that the other three fallbacks be audited and not assumed innocent — comment and review authors are the SAME expression, and a fix applied only to commits would leave this fixture red on the merge and comment rows.
